entries.dialogueText: "On top of this, the violence of war and the forced unification have left deep scars."

entries.dialogueText: "This distrust has already hindered voter registration, particularly in the less stable regions."

entries.dialogueText: "Despite being alien to many, the shift from a monarchy to a democratic system has been largely embraced."

entries.dialogueText: "While some older citizens have shown resistance to change, the opportunity to vote has sparked a wave of enthusiasm, particularly among those who were previously sidelined."

entries.dialogueText: "However, challenges remain. The local governance structures in Pales continue to clash with the nationalized systems being implemented by Rizia."

entries.dialogueText: "It's creating serious challenges for our logistical planning."

entries.dialogueText: "Sounds like a disaster waiting to happen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "We’ll press on. There’s no other option."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "So much for fair elections."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "From what I can tell, they’re not making it easy for themselves."

entries.dialogueText: "However, extensive destruction from the war has left much of Pales in disarray, with vital infrastructure severely compromised."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""While much of Pales is still recov..."
entries.dialogueText: "While much of Pales is still recovering, the damage to infrastructure is moderate but significant enough to cause disruption."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then we’ll control what we can. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then we’ll control what we can. Those who want to disrupt this will find we’re not as unprepared as they think."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Our military presence ensures secu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our military presence ensures security in the regions controlled by Rizia, facilitating the establishment of voting infrastructure where conditions permit."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""However, the division of Pales has..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the division of Pales has complicated the process, especially in regions still recovering from conflict."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "And families split between Rizia and Pales further complicate representation."

entries.dialogueText: "Tensions persist with Palesian local forces, but long-term integration is steadily underway, though it will likely take decades."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The division of Pales is marked by..."
entries.dialogueText: "The division of Pales is marked by conflict, though tensions remain manageable, particularly along the new shared border, with full integration expected to take decades."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Despite full funding dedicated to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite full funding dedicated to reparations, widespread bitterness and anger among Palesians makes reconciliation a prolonged and difficult process."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With full funding dedicated to rep..."
entries.dialogueText: "With full funding dedicated to reparations, tensions are slowly easing, however, a significant portion of the population still resents Rizia, complicating progress."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With full funding dedicated to rep..."
entries.dialogueText: "With full funding dedicated to reparations, substantial progress has been made."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Reparation efforts are ongoing, however, widespread bitterness and anger among many Palesians toward Rizia is making it a prolonged and difficult process."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Reparation efforts are ongoing, an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reparation efforts are ongoing, and while tensions are slowly easing, a significant portion of the population still resents Rizia, complicating progress."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Reparation efforts are ongoing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Reparation efforts are ongoing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It seems we've underestimated the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems we've underestimated the depth of their resentment. We'll have to push harder to smooth things over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Their bitterness is temporary. Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their bitterness is temporary. Rizia's faced worse and still emerged stronger."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Time has a way of healing even the deepest wounds."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But the lack of funding toward the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the lack of funding toward the agreed upon reparations cost has made any meaningful recovery impossible."

entries.dialogueText: "As a result, infrastructure lies in ruin, and food is scarce."

entries.dialogueText: "It became clear that if we failed to meet our obligation, it could reignite the war and provoke severe sanctions from the international community."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""While substantial progress has bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "While substantial progress has been made, lingering distrust and resentment from certain Palesian factions still hinder the complete healing of relations."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""As agreed, installments are being..."
entries.dialogueText: "As agreed, installments are being made over time."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "However, lingering distrust and resentment from certain Palesian factions still hinder the complete healing of relations."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""As for the upcoming election...""
entries.dialogueText: "As for the upcoming election..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""They’ll come around in time.""
entries.dialogueText: "They’ll come around in time."

entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure they’ll come around in time."

entries.dialogueText: "Some wounds aren't easily mended."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We'll get there.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll get there."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I believe that as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "I believe that as well."

entries.dialogueText: "Provided we give them reason to heal."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We always do.""
entries.dialogueText: "We always do."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Yes. We always do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. We always do."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato

entries.dialogueText: "As long as they’re willing to see reason."

entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, as a gesture of goodwill in Rizia's new leadership, the Republic of Lespia has offered us a generous loan to cover costs."

entries.dialogueText: "Which is why, under my direction, the House of Delegates has approved the seizure of a few choice assets from noble families. Your own included."

entries.dialogueText: "If it keeps us afloat, we have no choice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Trading one disaster for another... wonderful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "We’ll owe them for decades. But perhaps that’s the lesser evil."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Well done. Pales' swift reconstruction will be worth it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope they'll be paid back in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope they'll be paid back in the end."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "They’ll resist, but they can afford it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "If they’re true patriots, they’ll accept the burden."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Which assets?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Better to be in debt than in ruins."

entries.dialogueText: "That sounds suspiciously like corruption."

entries.dialogueText: "Good. It’s about time they paid their share."

entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't agree more."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava

entries.dialogueText: "For the greater good, yes."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava

entries.dialogueText: "The job had to be done."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I and my family keep our word.""
entries.dialogueText: "I and my family keep our word."

entries.dialogueText: "It's not an ideal situation, but it's the path we must take to maintain stability."

entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. It's not an ideal situation, but it's the path we must take to maintain stability."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The alternative would be far worse.""
entries.dialogueText: "The alternative would be far worse."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It’s a heavy price, but it may be..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s a heavy price, but it may be the only way forward."

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""But insufficient funding for the a..."
entries.dialogueText: "But insufficient funding for the agreed reparations has rendered any substantial recovery unattainable."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Consequently, infrastructure remai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Consequently, infrastructure remains in disrepair, and food is in short supply."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava

entries.dialogueText: "Lawlessness has reached unprecedented levels, sparking widespread resentment among Palesians toward Rizia."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""It became apparent that failing to..."
entries.dialogueText: "It became apparent that failing to fulfill our duty could reignite the war and invite harsh international sanctions."

entries.dialogueText: "As a result, communities remain shattered, and food is hard to come by."

entries.dialogueText: "Lawlessness is rampant, and the suffering of the Palesians has only grown, fueling their anger toward Rizia."

entries.dialogueText: "It became clear that if we failed to honor our commitment, it would not only reignite the war but bring even greater hardship to the people, along with severe international repercussions."

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The military's presence in Rizian-..."
entries.dialogueText: "The military's presence in Rizian-held areas is helping maintain order, giving us room to move forward with voting plans despite the conflict."

entries.dialogueText: "Even so, the ongoing violence has made it nearly impossible to hold a safe vote in much of Pales."

entries.dialogueText: "Displacement, threats, and violence are likely to suppress turnout and distort representation."

entries.dialogueText: "The military's presence may be holding some ground, but it's hardly enough to ensure a stable vote."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Early voting and absentee ballots..."
entries.dialogueText: "Early voting and absentee ballots have been introduced in calmer regions, but that's little comfort given the unrest elsewhere."

entries.dialogueText: "In truth, the fighting has made secure voting all but impossible in many parts of Pales."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""With people displaced, threatened,..."
entries.dialogueText: "With people displaced, threatened, or caught in the violence, turnout will be dismal, and representation skewed beyond repair."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The war has turned what should hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "The war has turned what should have been a clear process into a logistical nightmare."

entries.dialogueText: "Though unfamiliar to many, the move from monarchy to democracy has been widely welcomed."

entries.dialogueText: "Some older citizens have resisted the change, but the chance to vote has energized those who once felt excluded."

entries.dialogueText: "That said, challenges persist. Pales’ local governance still clashes with the national systems Rizia is trying to enforce."

entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The move from monarchy to democrac..."
entries.dialogueText: "The move from monarchy to democracy has given power back to the people -- a long-overdue step toward true equality."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""While some of the older generation..."
entries.dialogueText: "While some of the older generation cling to the past, a new wave of excitement is sweeping across the country, especially among those who once had no voice."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Of course, there are still hurdles..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, there are still hurdles. Pales’ long-standing leadership keeps resisting the national systems Rizia is putting in place."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava

entries.dialogueText: "Our military continues to ensure security, allowing for the establishment of voting infrastructure where conditions allow."

entries.dialogueText: "In relatively stable regions, electoral preparations are progressing as expected."

entries.dialogueText: "However, in areas still recovering from conflict, lingering instability has made securing the election far more difficult."

entries.dialogueText: "Many voters remain displaced, and even in stable communities, security fears have kept some from participating."

entries.dialogueText: "On top of that, the war has left lasting wounds."

entries.dialogueText: "Many in Pales remain wary of Rizia’s intentions, especially when it comes to the election."

entries.dialogueText: "For some, this whole thing feels like a trap -- like taking part could make them targets."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That fear has already kept plenty..."
entries.dialogueText: "That fear has already kept plenty of people from registering, especially in places where tensions are still high."

entries.dialogueText: "While Pales is still recovering, infrastructure damage -- though moderate -- has been significant enough to cause major disruptions."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava

entries.dialogueText: "However, extensive damage from the war has left much of Pales in disarray, with critical infrastructure severely damaged."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""As you can imagine, this has made..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you can imagine, this has made organizing the election far more difficult."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""This, in turn, has created conside..."
entries.dialogueText: "This, in turn, has created considerable obstacles for election planning."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""As expected, tensions persist betw..."
entries.dialogueText: "As expected, tensions persist between the conquered Palesians and the local Azaro government."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""As for the upcoming vote...""
entries.dialogueText: "As for the upcoming vote..."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The military's presence is keeping..."
entries.dialogueText: "The military's presence is keeping things from spiraling, which has allowed some groundwork for voting to begin -- but only where conditions allow."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""In relatively stable areas, voting..."
entries.dialogueText: "In relatively stable areas, voting prep is moving along -- slowly, but it’s happening."

entries.dialogueText: "This distrust has already hindered voter registration, particularly in regions that remain unstable."

entries.dialogueText: "While some areas are steady enough to manage, plenty of places are still too battered for things to run smoothly."

entries.dialogueText: "This, in turn, has made electoral operations an uphill battle."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato

entries.dialogueText: "This, in turn, has created significant challenges for electoral operations."

entries.dialogueText: "Reparation efforts continue, and though tensions are starting to ease, a significant portion of the population still resents Rizia, hindering progress."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""However, challenges remain. The lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, challenges remain. The local governance structures in Pales continue to clash with the systems implemented in the other provinces."

entries.dialogueText: "However, challenges remain. The local governance structures in Pales continue to clash with the systems implemented in the other provinces."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Of course, there are still hurdles..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, there are still hurdles. Pales’ long-standing leadership keeps resisting the systems Rizia's other provinces have put into place."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I thought Vina -- I mean, the Gran..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought Vina -- I mean, the Grand Duchess -- would be instrumental in getting out the vote. But she hasn't said a word one way or the other."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Fortunately, the Grand Duchess has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, the Grand Duchess has been instrumental in energizing the populace. Her encouragement will drive Palesians to the polls."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""And neither your daughter nor Duke..."
entries.dialogueText: "And neither your daughter nor Duke Reinhart have attempted to involve themselves in voter outreach efforts."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Fortunately, your daughter and Duk..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, your daughter and Duke Reinhart seem invested in making sure the process goes as smoothly as possible."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Our new Palesian voter bloc will b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our new Palesian voter bloc will be key to clinching an RNC majority, I believe."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I hope they come to their senses b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope they come to their senses before the elections. Our new Palesian voter bloc will be key to clinching an RNC majority."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Which is perhaps just as well. Mos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is perhaps just as well. Most Palesians are expected to align with the RNC thanks to their many happy years under the Reinharts."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""For better or worse. Most Palesian..."
entries.dialogueText: "For better or worse. Most Palesians are expected to align with the RNC thanks to their many happy years under the Reinharts."

entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""What's more, it seems the Princess..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's more, it seems the Princess of Rizia is not particularly invested in voter outreach."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""And here I thought she was too int..."
entries.dialogueText: "And here I thought she was too intelligent to buy into that succession nonsense."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Fortunately, the Princess of Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, the Princess of Rizia has very passionately involved herself in getting out the vote."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I always knew she was the real ref..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always knew she was the real reformist in your family."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Just as well. I wouldn't be surpri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just as well. I wouldn't be surprised if the Palesians went for the RNC. They're almost as conservative as your fellow Torases."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Unfortunately, it looks like a maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, it looks like a majority of Palesians look set to vote for the RNC. They're almost as conservative as your fellow Torases."

entries.title: Narrator: "He frowned."
entries.dialogueText: He frowned.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""As expected, tensions persist betw..."
entries.dialogueText: "As expected, tensions persist between the conquered Palesians and the local Crown-controlled government."

entries.dialogueText: "We have tried to foster unity by emphasizing that Palesians and Rizians alike have been liberated from the yoke of the nobility."

entries.dialogueText: "The costs of reconstruction have been fully paid off, but it is still expected to take some time before all of Pales is back to normal."
